scope: independent root audit of finite operator reconstruction, label discipline, fixed-M shift arithmetic, positivity boundary, moving-modulus scope, capacity, and zero booking

checks.canonical_format_repair: the draft's iff statement was narrowed: 4|j gives an integral parameter return, while actuality also requires s-9j/4>=1

mathematical_audit.finite_operators: The four order-three coefficient tables, exact fits and holdouts, and modular rank tests are reproducible finite identities. Without a symbolic telescoping certificate they remain EXACT FINITE ONLY and establish neither all-n recurrence nor minimality.
mathematical_audit.alignment: At fixed M, eliminating s and p gives s=(M-3h-2)/4 and p=(3M-h)/2. A same-ray shift h->h+3j is integral exactly when 4 divides j; it is an actual positive row only when the shifted s is at least one.
mathematical_audit.first_possible_return: The order-three window j=0,1,2,3 contains no second integral row. The first possible integral return is j=4, giving (h,s,p)->(h+12,s-9,p-6), and it is actual when s>=10.
mathematical_audit.moving_modulus_scope: A rational same-ray recurrence reduced modulo p remains an identity in F_p. It does not by itself imply divisibility at the returned selector p-6; a cross-prime reciprocity or common target-retaining carrier is additional arithmetic input.
mathematical_audit.capacity: Pointwise primitive height O(h) still aggregates to O(M^2), and the unreduced height aggregates to O(M^2 log M). Neither is an o(M) exceptional-mass bound; the fixed-j=1 ceiling remains 1/36.
